steps.text: Quantity break on TSM in APE-008: IBOR 12,400 vs custodian 24,800, IBOR short by 12,400 (USD -2,343,597.95). Share counts move for three reasons: trades that haven't settled (or won't), trades booked differently from what settled, and share events IBOR didn't process.
Both books hold it: IBOR 12,400, custodian 24,800. Pulling recent trades with their settlement status.
IBOR trades in the lookback window + custodian status
1 trade since 2026-11-05; every one of them shows SETTLED at the custodian.
custodian settlements in this account that IBOR booked somewhere else
No custodian settlements here that IBOR booked to a different account.
corporate actions on the security, with IBOR/custodian processing
No share events on this line recently.
Booking error explains -12,400 of -12,400 shares (100% fit, 1 item).
Conclusion: booking error, 96% confidence. Owner: Trade Support.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0186'
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    price_date,
    fx_rate,
    fx_source,
    fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM ibor_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'APE-008' AND security_id = 1025
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    as_of AS price_date,
    fx_rate,
    'WMR_4PM' AS fx_source,
    as_of AS fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM custodian_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'APE-008' AND security_id = 1025
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: IBOR trades in the lookback window + custodian status
queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.trade_id,
  t.trade_type,
  t.side,
  t.quantity,
  t.trade_date,
  t.settle_date,
  t.counterparty,
  t.ca_ref,
  t.booked_by,
  s.account_id AS cust_account,
  s.side AS cust_side,
  s.matched_quantity,
  s.settled_quantity,
  s.status AS cust_status,
  s.fail_reason,
  s.settled_on
FROM trades AS t
LEFT JOIN custodian_settlements AS s
  ON s.trade_ref = t.trade_id
WHERE
  t.account_id = 'APE-008' AND t.security_id = 1025 AND t.trade_date >= '2026-11-05'
ORDER BY
  t.trade_date,
  t.trade_id
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: custodian settlements in this account that IBOR booked somewhere else
queries.sql:
SELECT
  s.trade_ref,
  s.account_id AS cust_account,
  s.side,
  s.matched_quantity,
  s.settled_quantity,
  s.status,
  s.settled_on,
  t.account_id AS ibor_account,
  t.booked_by
FROM custodian_settlements AS s
LEFT JOIN trades AS t
  ON t.trade_id = s.trade_ref
WHERE
  s.account_id = 'APE-008'
  AND s.security_id = 1025
  AND (
    t.account_id IS NULL OR t.account_id <> s.account_id
  )
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: corporate actions on the security, with IBOR/custodian processing
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ca.ca_id,
  ca.ca_type,
  ca.ex_date,
  ca.pay_date,
  ca.ratio_new,
  ca.ratio_old,
  ca.rate,
  p.ibor_status,
  p.processed_at,
  cp.qty_change AS cust_qty_change,
  cp.cash_amount AS cust_cash
FROM corporate_actions AS ca
LEFT JOIN ca_processing AS p
  ON p.ca_id = ca.ca_id AND p.account_id = 'APE-008'
LEFT JOIN custodian_ca_postings AS cp
  ON cp.ca_id = ca.ca_id AND cp.account_id = 'APE-008'
WHERE
  ca.security_id = 1025 AND ca.ex_date >= '2026-11-05'
ORDER BY
  ca.ex_date
LIMIT 200

finding.summary: Booking error. IBOR 12,400 vs custodian 24,800 [Q2:r0, Q2:r1]. T4197461 is a SELL in IBOR but the custodian settled a BUY of 6,200 (-12,400) [Q3:r0]. That accounts for the full -12,400 share difference.

evidence.note: T4197461 is a SELL in IBOR but the custodian settled a BUY of 6,200 (-12,400)

finding.proposed_fix: Amend T4197461 side SELL -> BUY to match the settled trade.
